DC Explosion and DC Implosion.fact: The "DC Explosion" and "DC Implosion" were two events in 1978 – the first an official marketing campaign, the second a sardonic reference to it – in which American comics company DC Comics expanded their roster of publications, then abruptly cut it back. Edvard Magnus Rodhe.question: He completed his Bachelor of Arts (filosofie kandidat) degree in _____, and completed his theology degree in 1904, after having spent time at the universities of Leipzig, Marburg and Berlin
